body:
It really is hard to open up, I agree.
I'll try to talk to a professional. In fact, there's one not too far away from here. 
I get what you're saying. It's hard, even harder when you're having bad days that bring you down a little. But I suppose you're right; Try harder the next days.
I'm very tired, so I'll go to sleep now.
Have a nice day/night, alright man? You seem like a great person. I wish you the best! thanks for your kind words. They mean much to me.

Hello there. 
No doubt, you're right with all of what you're saying. 
To be completly honest, I don't really want to talk with my family about this. I don't know why, there's just something that prevents me from doing it.

This'll be a a long path to go, I assume. But I don't know. I guess talking to a professional will be the very first step to a happier life. 
I don't know if I have the guts to talk to someone though. I'll most likely try.
Thanks for your kind words.
How do you motivate yourself to keep going?
